title: Amephish
description: Add the Amephish a mythical fish that grants Haste
body:
This is a datapack/resourcepack bundle that adds the **Amephish**. A mythical amethyst infused salmon that grants haste upon eating.

Obtained through fishing. 
Uncommon rarity.
Grants Haste II for 4 minuites.
Gives hunger points equilivent to raw beef.

Made during a need for haste in a pre beacon world in recent server ive been playing with my friends.
